content.title: CBS Sports Golazo on Instagram: "Pep was especially excited to beat Arsenal in the Carabao Cup final 😤"
content.text: Never miss a post from cbssportsgolazoSign up for Instagram to stay in the loop.Pep was especially excited to beat Arsenal in the Carabao Cup final 😤Arsenal is soo ovareted this season 🌝🌚Let's all gather and laugh at Arsenal>>>>>>>That's why he is the best coach......he knows it's not easy and he respects the game coz he knows he can be in same position.......listen to his words they are heavy and respectfulI hate that Arsenal fans always fall in these Mind games of us being the strongest…. City is the strongestGreat respect for Pep. Arsenal did great in the first 20 minutes, then Pep reorganized the team and went full pressure from the rest of the first half until they made it 2x0. Congrats to the champions, more three competitions to fight for. COYG ⚪🔴Can't wait for city to win EPL tooGreatest of all time ❤️I love him so muchFeels like you and Arteta have a secret partnership. Well played. The best team won. CongratulationsGreatest coach.
